title: Fade
description: Fades a sound in or out, in bars or seconds, and ends in exact silence. The same as a volume gain with fadein(...) or fadeout(...).

parameters.name: enabled
parameters.doc: Off passes the sound through unchanged.

parameters.name: direction
parameters.doc: out: the sound goes from full to silence. in: it goes from silence to full.

parameters.name: start
parameters.doc: Where the fade starts: a bar position (1 is the first bar, 5.5 is half way through bar 5) or seconds from the beginning of the song (12s).

parameters.name: length
parameters.doc: How long the fade takes: bars (2, 0.5) or seconds (1.5s).

parameters.name: shape
parameters.doc: lin: a straight line in volume. equal: equal power (use it for a crossfade). exp: starts slowly and ends fast.

parameters.name: channels
parameters.doc: auto: stereo when an input or the source is stereo, otherwise mono; mono: sum to mono; stereo: always two channels (a mono sound is copied to both).
